question: The simple interest on a principal amount (in ₹) is ₹177 for a period of 5 years at the rate of 2% per annum. The principal amount (in ₹) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective rate of interest for 5 years at 2% per annum = 5 × 2% = 10%

Let the principal amount be 100%.

Given that 10% of Principal = ₹177

Principal (100%) = 177 × 10 = ₹1770

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1770.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹177

Time (T) = 5 years

Rate (R) = 2% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 
 Principal
 P = ?
 
• 
 

 Time = 5 years
 Rate = 2% p.a.
 
 Simple Interest
 ₹177
 Total Interest = 10% of P

**Calculation:**

⇒ 177 = (P × 2 × 5) ÷ 100

⇒ 177 = (P × 10) ÷ 100

⇒ 177 = P ÷ 10

⇒ P = 177 × 10

⇒ P = 1770

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1770.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

It is calculated only on the principal amount. The interest earned remains constant for every equal time period.

Amount Formula

Amount (A) = Principal + Simple Interest = P(1 + RT ÷ 100).

Difference Between SI and CI

The difference between Simple Interest and Compound Interest for 2 years on the same principal and rate is P(R ÷ 100)².
